validity.recommendation: No fill needed. Keep Diameter blank (and LengthKnownKm = 0.00, as already recorded) -- this is the correct, expected state for a compression-only capacity expansion with no new mainline pipe. Do not carry over the wiki's '12 in; 24 in; 30 in; 30-inches' list onto this row, and do not use the 48-in/42-in figures found in the project description -- those are compressor-station suction/discharge process piping, not transmission pipeline diameter.
validity.researcher_notes: The Louisiana Xpress Project is a compressor-station capacity expansion, filed by Columbia Gulf Transmission, LLC (not Columbia Gas Transmission LLC -- see entity note below), across East Carroll, Catahoula, Evangeline and Rapides parishes, Louisiana. FERC EA-availability notice (joint with Kinder Morgan Louisiana Pipeline's separate Acadiana Project), Federal Register Vol. 84, No. 189, Sept. 30, 2019, p. 51534 (govinfo package 2019-21048; the notice's own printed FR Doc. number at page-bottom reads 2019-21140 -- both numbers point to the same retrieved document, a discrepancy I am noting rather than silently picking one): 'Columbia Gulf proposes to construct and operate three new greenfield compressor stations, and modify one existing compressor station... Each new compressor station... would include two 23,470 hp natural gas turbine driven compressors..., gas cooling bays, 48-inch-diameter suction and 42-inch-diameter discharge piping, and related appurtenant facilities.' The 48/42-inch figures are explicitly compressor-station suction/discharge header piping, not a transmission-line diameter, and I deliberately excluded them from consideration as a Diameter fill (per the brief's own gotcha about compressor process piping vs. mainline diameter). No new pipeline segment is described anywhere in the notice; the project is stations and appurtenant facilities only. This confirms the sheet's LengthKnownKm=0.00 as correct and the blank Diameter as the right answer per standing protocol. ENTITY NOTE (not escalated as a new flag, since only Diameter is flagged on this row): the FERC notice's applicant is 'Columbia Gulf Transmission, LLC', a corporate entity distinct from 'Columbia Gas Transmission LLC', which is the Owner/PipelineName recorded on this sheet row. This may be worth a human's attention on a future Operator/Owner pass, but is out of scope for the flagged Diameter question here.
